title: Godot editor crashed when expanding Material Overrides in inspector
body: ### Tested versions Cannot be reproduced in Godot 4.6-stable, can be reproduced in bf95b62586e31b8a3503f5903d7764d7c52bf2ab (godot 4.7) ### System information Godot v4.7.dev.mono (bf95b6258) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 09 Feb 2026 17:16:33 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 OEM (nvidia; 590.48.01) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700F (20 threads) - 15.39 GiB memory ### Issue description Details is in [godot_voxel issue](https://github.com/Zylann/godot_voxel/issues/845). I incorrectly reported this issue to godot voxel before. I will paste the content in this issue here: **Describe the bug** When I expand the Material Overrides menu in inspector in VoxelCube, the editor will crash. If I modify this property in script, it will works. But when I expand other node or other property, it will not crash. Such as if I expand Material Overrides in MeshInstance, it will work. What's more, it will only crash when I am using forward+, if I turn to mobile, it will work. This issue seems to be not caused by godot_voxel, but I can only reproduced it with this module. So I provide a project which needs godot_voxel as dependency. Choose the terrarin Click it and editor will crash immediately ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [minimal.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25313850/minimal.zip)
